name: MPRODoubleRewardAutoStake unwrapWETH lets anyone withdraw the reward WETH
summary: MPRODoubleRewardAutoStake.unwrapWETH(amount, to) is public and, checking only that the contract holds enough WETH, unwraps the requested amount of the reward-token WETH and sends the ether to any recipient. An MEV bot transferred flash-loaned WETH into the staking proxy, called unwrapWETH for 104.83 ETH to itself, repaid the loan and kept the 3.98 WETH of staker rewards; four hours later it did the same to the sibling MPRO staking proxy 0xbd809716 for 6.0 WETH.
notes: Reset is the upgrade to 0xd971fd39 (unverified; it carries the unwrapWETH selector 0xe16d9ce5 and the trace shows it paying 104.83 ETH to the caller). The previous implementation 0x2047c460 (verified, same function without access control) ran only from block 29864325; the original 0xdf70ba49 had no unwrapWETH. The proxy's earlier WETH withdrawals were reward-sized (largest 0.0031 WETH).

The campaign transaction hit the sibling proxy 0xbd809716 (same deployer and template), then running implementation 0xfe72866f installed at block 30174946, which kept the same public unwrapWETH. DeFiHackLabs names the incident Unwarp.
